thread:
alex_k: Heads up — early-stage startup (Seed, US) asks for 90-day free credits + extended trial for POC. Quick context:

Customer: MindLink (NDA inbound)
POC goal: LLM-assisted search + embeddings (10m tokens/day peak)
Asking: $150k credits or 3 months free, plus lowered rate cap for warm traffic.

priya_desai: they signed up from the accelerator promo page, pinged us yesterday. CEO wants to start next week.

ravi_se: technical note — their eval needs Dedicated-like throughput; recommend we offer Dedicated trial or increase hosted quotas. Could we include a performance SLA for 1k reqs/min?

marco_dd: Deal desk: we can approve up to $50k credits via standard promo. Anything above needs finance + sales leadership sign-off. tx: @emily_sales_ops

alex_k: thanks. They explicitly requested $150k credits but open to a blended approach (credits + commit). Any precedent for 3mo trial + reduced overage rate?

emily_sales_ops: precedents: last quarter we did 2mo + $75k credits w/ 6mo minimum commit for startups in accelerator. Must include usage cap and sunset clause. Need ROI plan from AE.

jenna_fin: Finance: we need forecasted usage and ARR conversion estimate. If we do credits >$75k, require a 12mo revenue commitment or an upfront prepay. Also check KYC.

marco_dd: Also add promo code limits and single-use. If team asks for rate cap, we can set temporary rate card for trial period only.

alex_k: Customer timeline is aggressive. Can we get a "soft approval" to tell them yes to a 60-day trial + up to $75k credits, conditional on commit conversation? I'll draft terms.

priya_desai: I'll prepare the POC success criteria and conversion targets — will post by EOD.

dealdesk-bot: Request logged: DD-2026-487. Requires manager approval and finance sign-off. Link: https://redwood.internal/deals/DD-2026-487

marco_dd: I can approve $75k today. For extra, escalate to @VP_Sales. Also legal may require standard promo addendum.

alex_k: Ok sending customer note: "We can offer a 60-day trial with $75k credits, subject to usage caps and a follow-up commercial review." Will include the POC SLA and conversion KPIs.

ravi_se: I'll scope infra needs and add a short runbook for the POC (batching, KV cache, perf targets).

emily_sales_ops: Once Priya posts the KPI doc, I'll draft the promo addendum and submit for legal and finance.

priya_desai: posted now: https://docs.redwood/mindlink-poc-kpis (summary: 3 endpoints, expected 100 req/s, target conversion 20% ARR within 6mo)

alex_k: Great. Marco — if you approve $75k, I'll reply to customer and get the NDA started.

marco_dd: Approved $75k. :thumbsup: Escalation channel open if they push for $150k.

alex_k: Thanks team — wrapping up. I'll post final customer email and DD ticket closure here.
